name: Bank Hapoalim
verdict: OWNABLE (RP_FAIR, low priority) — fair not cheap; ladder only at the sub-fair rungs; REJECT as edge
entry_band: SKIP the 6,900 rung (that's paying fair for fair) — GTC ladder at 6,600 / 6,300 agorot only (the rungs where expected TR clears COE with margin); sleeve <=1%; LUMI = quality-tilt alt at ~10% richer multiple; Form 1116 FTC filing REQUIRED for the carry math

carry.note: 25% Israeli WHT largely FTC-creditable — incremental cost vs domestic qualified is only ~5pp (~23bps of yield); NIIT+CA uncreditable; ~10-15% of return via buyback = WHT-free

kill_triggers: construction-credit NPLs rising / coverage falling / major developer default (construction credit grew +40% in 2025 INTO 9 straight months of falling home prices, 83,500 unsold units — THE honest bear)

court_record.dd: two-mode DD REFUTED the Stage-0 thesis at its own arithmetic: (1) the 'equities lag the sovereign' leg is FALSE — TA-Banks +60.9% in 2025, the equity re-rated WITH the spread; (2) justified P/B (COE 11.25% = ILS 10yr 3.73 + ~1.1x ERP; normalized ROE 13.5% post windfall-tax -130-140bps and BoI cuts; g 4.5%) = 1.33x vs traded 1.37x = ON TOP of fair; LUMI 1.45-1.55x fair-to-rich; (3) funding moat VERIFIED stronger than claimed (top-5 = 98% of assets, declared oligopoly); (4) WHT hard math: 42.1% all-in top-bracket CA -> keep 57.9c/$1; carry 2.6% net not 4.5%; (5) windfall tax LIVE not fully enacted (litigated, High Court pending) = the structural multiple cap AND the bull option (repeal). Conviction: 3/10 as edge / 6/10 as fair compounder. POLI over LUMI narrowly (same sustainable ROE, 10% cheaper; LUMI the better franchise — 29.1% cost/income best-in-system)
court_record.adjudication: accepted; deployment priority LOW (thinnest carry on the current fair-carry menu: FNF 4.2% qualified+gearing, EQT 8-9% FCF yield+torque, PEO 5.6% net all rank ahead); ladder set at sub-fair rungs only

edge_explainer.market_believes: Israeli banks carry a war discount worth harvesting as the ceasefire holds.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The discount already left — the banking index rose 61% last year as the sovereign normalized, and today's multiple sits exactly on what a 13.5% sustainable ROE justifies at an 11%+ cost of equity. Fair, not cheap; the real risk is domestic (construction lending grew 40% into a falling housing market), not geopolitical.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None — and we say so. The two things that would create one (windfall-tax repeal, or a housing-credit panic overshooting) are both exogenous; the ladder at 6,600/6,300 is positioned for the second.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It is priced in — that's the verdict.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Q2 prints ~mid-Aug (NIM under cuts + construction asset quality); the Knesset windfall-tax vote + High Court challenge; BoI's cut path to 3.5%.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: P/B re-rating above 1.6x would prove the COE compressed below even our bull case — trim/exit into it.

catalyst_overlays.call: WAIVED — crowd prices ~98% hold (Poly); already in the price, residual = Phase-II-collapse tail

sizing: 1.0% position across two rungs (280@6600 + 285@6300 agorot) pending Monday unit-verify
